source_snapshot.test_name_items: All SAS/SATA Slot Number Check - NVMe
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe via NVMe adapter slot number is correctly

1. Insert all NVMe SSD into BP slot and check slot number

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. Check system spec define slot number

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: OS NVMe enumeration with truncated id-ctrl.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; uses NVMe device order to claim SAS/SATA slots, omits physical placement and does not validate the linked SAS/SATA script.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; requires transport resolution, authoritative slot source, physical evidence and script validation.

original_test_intent: Verify every approved drive's physical slot number, but the master record conflicts between a SAS/SATA case/script path and an NVMe adapter/SSD procedure.
original_method: Keep SAS/SATA HBA/enclosure/SAS-address mapping separate from NVMe PCIe/controller/namespace mapping. After an owner selects the transport, an operator populates labeled bays and the agent joins an authoritative firmware/BMC/vendor slot ID to serial identities.
manual_activity: Physical insertion and bay-label evidence are core, but incompatible transport claims prevent selecting hardware, slot namespace and authoritative mapping safely.
required_inputs: Power-state/ESD procedure, operator evidence and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Do not populate bays while transport/compatibility is unresolved.
Exclude boot, protected, data-bearing and unknown drives.
Never infer physical slots from `/dev/nvmeX`, `lsblk` or enumeration order.
Do not initialize, format, mount or alter firmware/BIOS/BMC state.
No automatic reseat, renumber, reboot or alternate-transport attempt.
agent_execution_scope: Record the conflict and review the referenced script only for the selected future transport.
After resolution, capture authoritative slot data and full transport-specific topology.
Build an exact serial-to-physical-bay correlation table.
Do not claim physical placement or verdict.
engineer_actions: Resolve transport and authoritative slot source.
Approve/perform every drive placement and record physical labels.
Resolve ambiguous mapping and issue PASS/FAIL.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Inapplicable before scope resolution and insufficient afterward: NVMe indexes are not physical slots, output is truncated and cannot validate SAS/SATA mappings.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use no generic device-order mapping; after decision, combine the approved script with authoritative firmware/BMC slot fields and complete transport topology.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SAS/SATA title/script, NVMe procedure, slot criterion and 15/8-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After resolution, produce a manifest linking physical bay, enclosure/backplane port, controller path and drive serial, backed by operator photos and authoritative slot output.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record script commit, BIOS/BMC, controller/adapter firmware, driver and tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Selected platform slot map and source script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds durable identity mapping and separates transports.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS device names are unstable enumeration artifacts.

project_override_considerations: A project override may choose one transport and declared all-drive population; results cannot cover the other transport or unpopulated bays.
expected_evidence: Owner scope decision, population and authoritative slot specification
Selected transport's firmware/BMC/vendor map and full topology/identity output
Script transcript if approved, final health, Tool Result and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Test Set/item/script path say SAS/SATA while procedure and DeepSeek command target NVMe. Their controller addressing and physical slot sources are not interchangeable.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A physical slot result has no determinate transport or authoritative namespace until owner resolution, so execution is genuinely blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects YES and `/dev/nvme` order as physical slot proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts scope/mapping safeguards and changes conditional partial to BLOCKED.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats the script as a versioned, transport-scoped artifact rather than presumed authority.

review_improvement: Prevents false slot mapping from volatile OS names and a mismatched script path.
independent_technical_reasoning: Physical slot numbering is platform- and transport-specific. Without knowing whether the HBA/enclosure or NVMe adapter is authoritative, no valid correlation can be built.

source_provenance.history: Exact-code repository search including source script URL

no_automatic_retry: No physical placement, script run or alternate mapping attempt is allowed before scope resolution.
